Book IX, 210: On the “Tactics” of Orbicius
Book XI, Epigram 45: Ad senem Orbum
Now sinks the glowing orb of day
Now sinks the fiery orb of day
Sonnet: Night's dewy orb, that o'er yon limpid stream
Fragment: The Sun (for now his orb 'gan slowly sink)
Fragment: The Moon, how definite its orb
The royal sun with his orbed flame
